content.title: Recoverable Failure | A Body Trait Solves the Task
content.summary: Establish an original character through habitat, waking behavior, and locomotion. Let a technical task produce a recoverable mistake, then make the character's distinctive physical trait the tool that resolves it and hold the character beside the visible result.

quick_start.input_format: Original character residence and movement + technical tasks + recoverable mistakes + physical characteristics breakthrough + results in the same frame
quick_start.recommended_input: The translucent paper moth weatherman woke up in the brass weather tower, encountered a gust error in calibrating the prism barometer, then used wing vein projection to diagnose the airflow and repaired it, and finally held up a raindrop.
required_anchors: Establish habitat, intimate reaction and locomotion before the technical task.
Show one skilled task with a readable intermediate state.
Use one identity-defining body feature as a practical tool in the solution.
End with the repaired or transformed object and a restrained competence pose together.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish an original character through habitat, waking behavior, and locomotion. Let a technical task produce a recoverable mistake, then make the character's distinctive physical trait the tool that resolves it and hold the character beside the visible result.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Introduce one original character through habitat, wake behavior and locomotion before assigning a skilled task. Let the first technical attempt create a visible recoverable failure, then make the character use one identity-defining body feature as a practical reasoning or control instrument. The success state must visibly answer the failure and end in a clean competence pose with the changed object.

invariants.rule: Establish habitat, intimate reaction and locomotion before the technical task.
invariants.purpose: Builds personality and physical rules before judging skill.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting at the workbench reduces the character to a decorative technician.

invariants.rule: Show one skilled task with a readable intermediate state.
invariants.purpose: Makes later failure specific and inspectable.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unexplained accident cannot prove what changed.

invariants.rule: Keep the failure recoverable and preserve the same task object.
invariants.purpose: Supports causal repair instead of reset magic.
invariants.ablation_failure: Replacing the object erases the consequence.

invariants.rule: Use one identity-defining body feature as a practical tool in the solution.
invariants.ablation_failure: If any generic tool solves the problem, the body design is only ornament.

invariants.rule: End with the repaired or transformed object and a restrained competence pose together.
invariants.purpose: Provides visible proof of learning and success.
invariants.ablation_failure: A reaction without the result cannot close the task.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is readable without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: carrier_or_token
slots.constraint: One visible material, prop or symbolic anchor that carries the causal mechanism.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: A sequence of visible, causally ordered changes rather than decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each change without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final state that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of visible-action sounds; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: Ayotl name and source folklore attribution
source turtle-like creature, shell markings and color design
hammock wake-up, floating gears, crystal experiment and source equations
the exact source workshop, explosion, self-writing surface and hero pose
